transcript: Hi Ava! Let's explore the cozy homes where our animal friends live and grow. Look at the tall, golden grass! A mother lion rests in the shade of a big acacia tree. Animals need food, water, and a safe place to sleep to stay healthy and happy in the wild. Under the waves, colorful fish swim through the coral reefs. This watery world provides everything they need to survive. Can you help match each animal to the special place where they belong? Now it is your turn to help these animals find their perfect homes!
